result: Self-healing monitor workflow deployed. Heartbeat and diagnostics workflows fixed — pull_request trigger removed, was root cause of 0s startup failures.
fixes_applied: Removed pull_request trigger from bridge-runner-diagnostics.yml — GitHub withholds secrets on PR context, causing PRE_RUNTIME_0S failures
Removed pull_request trigger from bridge-runner-heartbeat.yml — same root cause
Added push trigger to both workflows so they fire on file changes
Created self-healing-monitor.yml: detect → classify → rerun → incident issue → receipt

classification_map.PRE_RUNTIME_0S: Workflow aborted before any step — config/permissions/billing
classification_map.PR_CONTEXT_SECRET_WITHHELD: PR trigger withholds secrets by GitHub security design
classification_map.SECRET_OR_ENV_MISSING: Required secret not set or not scoped to this repo
classification_map.APP_RUNTIME_FAILURE: Workflow started but application code failed

gaps: Secrets BRIDGE_ENDPOINT, BRIDGE_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY still need to be set in repo Settings → Secrets if not already present
72h survivability test not yet complete — monitor must run unattended for 72h to prove full autonomy claim
next_action: Monitor self-runs every 30min. Check bridge/receipts/self-healing-detection.json after first automated run.
